title: Montreal Walking and Metro Tour Culture History and Diversity
includes: Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
24-hour Metro/Bus pass included!

Off the beaten track city tour, we will show you the real Montreal. A blend of classic touristic locations but also lesser-visited historical areas that will make you feel like a local!

Explore Montreal with us on this engaging 2-hour walking and metro tour led by a bilingual guide. Discover the city’s rich history and vibrant culture as you wander through the arts district, downtown, the Southwest and iconic neighborhoods such as Old Montreal. This tour is perfect for travelers looking to immerse themselves in Montreal’s unique atmosphere and gain insider knowledge from a passionate local.

- 2-hour guided walking and metro tour led by a bilingual local
- Visit key neighborhoods including Downtown, the Southwest boroughs, Old Montreal
- Explore vibrant Atwater market for local insights and produce
- Ideal for travelers seeking cultural and historical experiences in Montreal
